title: OXR acceptance identity
statement: Let $n\ge 0$, let $\delta\in[0,1]$, and let $f:\{\pm1\}^n\to[-1,1]$ be odd. For each $S\subseteq[n]$, write $\widehat f(S)$ for its Fourier coefficient and set $A_\delta(S)=\sum_{K\subseteq[n]}(1-\delta)^{|K|}\delta^{n-|K|}(-1)^{|S\cap K|}\widehat f(S\cap K)$. Then the acceptance probability of the three-query OXR test with parameter $\delta$ is $\frac34-\frac14\operatorname{Stab}_{-\delta}(f)-\frac14\sum_{S\subseteq[n]}\widehat f(S)^2 A_\delta(S)$, where $\operatorname{Stab}_{-\delta}(f)$ is the noise stability at correlation $-\delta$.
